# DIME Industries
> Award-winning cannabis vapes, edibles, and prerolls — lab-tested hardware and extracts since 2016.

DIME Industries is a licensed cannabis brand helping adult consumers and retailers find authentic, lab-tested products online and at licensed stores. Synonyms: DIME, Dime Industries, dime carts, dimecarts.
